about:
CPI Precision Plastics LLC, operating from North Royalton, Ohio, was founded in 1994. The company has built over three decades of experience in plastic injection molding, though the names of its founders are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides comprehensive injection molding services that span design and engineering, rapid prototyping, material selection, precision molding, quality assurance, and a suite of secondary operations including assembly, machining, ultrasonic welding, pad printing, and custom packaging. They work with a wide range of engineering and commodity thermoplastics and emphasize sustainable manufacturing practices. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Industries served include energy, construction, retail, industrial, and medical sectors.

The company differentiates itself through a customer-centric, hands-on approach that begins at the first interaction and continues through delivery, a commitment to on-time delivery and competitive pricing, over 30 years of industry experience, and continuous investment in state-of-the-art equipment and innovative solutions.
